title: In silico and structure-based assessment to classify VUS identified in the alpha-helical domain of BRCA2.
authors: Khan, Mudassar Ali; Varma, Ashok K
one_liner_zh: 该文用多种in silico工具和分子动力学模拟评估BRCA2蛋白α螺旋结构域中的VUS突变对蛋白结构稳定性的影响，虽涉及蛋白-DNA修复相关蛋白，但未聚焦TF-DNA结合或互作机制，方法以突变效应预测为主，与课题核心关联较弱。
abstract: Breast cancer type 2 susceptibility (BRCA2) protein plays a crucial role in DNA double-strand breaks repair mechanism by homologous recombination. Pathogenic mutations in the BRCA2 gene confer an increased risk of hereditary breast and ovarian cancer (HBOC). Different missense mutations are identified from a larger cohort of patient populations in the BRCA2. However, most missense mutations are classified as 'Variants of Uncertain Significance' (VUS) due to a lack of data from structural, functional, and clinical assessments. Therefore, this study focused on assessing VUS identified in the alpha-helical domain of h-BRCA2 using different in silico tools and structure-based molecular dynamics simulation. A total of 286 identified VUS were evaluated using Align-GVGD, PROVEAN and PANTHER servers and 18 variants were predicted to be pathogenic. Further, out of 18 variants analyzed using the ConSurf server, 16 variants were found to be evolutionary conserved. These 16 conserved variants were submitted to PremPS and Dynamut server to assess the effect of the mutation at the protein structure level; 12 mutations were predicted to have a destabilizing effect on the native protein structure. Finally, molecular dynamics simulations revealed 5 variants BRCA2 Cys2646Tyr, Asp2665Val, Trp2619Arg, Trp2619Ser and Tyr2660Cys can alter the folding pattern and need further validation using in vitro, structural and in vivo studies to classify as pathogenic.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌2型易感性（BRCA2）蛋白在同源重组介导的DNA双链断裂修复机制中发挥关键作用。BRCA2基因的致病性突变增加了遗传性乳腺癌和卵巢癌（HBOC）的风险。在BRCA2中，从更大的患者群体队列中鉴定出不同的错义突变。然而，由于缺乏结构、功能和临床评估数据，大多数错义突变被归类为“意义不确定的变异”（VUS）。因此，本研究侧重于使用不同的计算机工具和基于结构的分子动力学模拟，评估在h-BRCA2的α-螺旋结构域中鉴定出的VUS。使用Align-GVGD、PROVEAN和PANTHER服务器评估了总共286个已鉴定的VUS，其中18个变异被预测为致病性。进一步，在通过ConSurf服务器分析的18个变异中，发现16个变异在进化上保守。将这16个保守变异提交至PremPS和Dynamut服务器，以评估突变在蛋白质结构水平上的影响；预测12个突变对天然蛋白质结构具有去稳定化效应。最后，分子动力学模拟揭示，5个变异BRCA2 Cys2646Tyr、Asp2665Val、Trp2619Arg、Trp2619Ser和Tyr2660Cys可能改变折叠模式，需要进一步通过体外、结构和体内研究进行验证，以将其分类为致病性。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
